scientific_integrity: The self-review and exact symbolic checker are disclosed. Independent external audit and validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equilibrium counts and generic local fold/transcritical types for \(\rho\le0\) only; no classification of global attractors, limit cycles, or global stability. Root/discriminant polynomial derived in prior published work. Unindexed negative-parameter literature could overlap.
title: Two negative folds and a transcritical collision in the ETM-3D equilibrium diagram
